headline: Ashish Kacholia offloads nearly 1% stake in Xpro India
hook: Prominent investor trims stake in Xpro India
summary: Ace investor Ashish Kacholia has sold a 0.98% stake in Xpro India through an open market transaction. The sale involved the disposal of approximately 1.2 lakh shares of the company. Kacholia held a 3.56% stake in the firm as of the quarter ended June 2024. Retail investors often track the portfolio movements of prominent market participants to gauge sentiment on specific stocks.
why_it_matters: Selling by marquee investors can signal reduced confidence in near-term growth.
winners_losers: Xpro India shareholders hurt / Kacholia gains
